# Photopods

> Share photos and videos in pods — private folders, invite-only groups, or fully public topic feeds. React with emoji, invite your people, keep your moments together.

## What is Photopods?
Photopods is a photo and video sharing app built around "pods". A pod can be private (just you), shared (invite-only for friends and family), or public (a topic feed anyone can browse). Drop photos and videos in, react with emoji, and share moments with the people who matter.

## Key pages
- / — your pods (sign in to create and view)
- /pods/discover — browse public pods
- /pods/new — create a pod
- /contact — support
